description: Scottish Public Electric Vehicle Charging - ChargePlace Scotland October 2022 to March 2024 is a data set deposited in University of Strathclyde by its authors Kathleen Davies. Dataset developed and analysed in Plugging-In Caledonia: Location and utilisation of public electric vehicle chargers in Scotland. Dataset contains data (sourced from ChargePlace Scotland) concerning electric vehicle charging sessions taking place on the ChargePlace Scotland public network between October 2022 and March 2024, specifically including the start date and time of each session, the charge ... Coverage: national (GB); the metadata date the deposit to 2024. Formats: ZIP. Size stated: 143MB. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
